title: Firefighter 1 & 2
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

not_verbatim: Display the personal and professional attitude and discipline necessary for employment in the firefighting profession
why: not in the catalog text as printed: Display the personal and professional attitude and discipline necessary for empl

outcomes: Perform manipulate skills and pass written tests that meet the National Fire Protection Association Standard 1001 and the California State Fire Marshal standard for Firefighter 1 & 2
Demonstrate specific skills, knowledge and abilities in routine and emergency firefighting operations
Display the personal and professional attitude and discipline necessary for employment in the firefighting profession

notes: The catalog prints FIRE 050; it was matched to closed-list FIRE 50 (same title, Principles of Emergency Services), so it is not marked as a catalog addition.
The outcomes lead-in refers to the 'Firefighter 1 Academy Certificate of Achievement' rather than 'Firefighter 1 & 2'; the outcomes are printed in this award's section and were recorded for it.
The PDF text uses ligature glyphs (e.g. 'ﬁ ', 'Ɵ '). These were normalized to plain letters in the outcomes and the career.
'Required Major Total Units 40' is printed and matches the sum of the listed courses. The description also states the certificate is obtained by completing the 40-unit major.
All EMS courses require a minimum grade of B. All FIRE courses require a minimum grade of C, or P if taken Pass/No Pass.
Course descriptions on page 285 (FIRE 051, 053, 054, 056) are not part of this certificate's requirements.
